name: UploadThing
tagline: File uploads for modern apps with SDKs, callbacks, and dashboard.
shortDescription: UploadThing provides developer-friendly file uploads, SDKs, route handlers, callbacks, and file management APIs.
agentSummary: Agents can wire app uploads quickly in supported frameworks and inspect upload routes and file metadata.
bestFor: App file uploads, image attachment flows, and developer-friendly media ingestion.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: File access rules, malware scanning needs, and deletion policies need product review. Schema changes, migrations, deletes, backups, row-level security, and retention policies need explicit review before agents touch production data. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Store credentials outside source control and use least-privilege scopes, short-lived tokens, or restricted keys where the product supports them.
pricingSummary: Public storage/bandwidth pricing with free tier.
authModel: API keys, app IDs, server-side route auth, and callback validation.
browserSupport: Dashboard supports apps, files, keys, and usage.

capabilities.detail: Docs cover server SDKs, file routes, callbacks, ACLs, and upload APIs.
Pricing is public by storage and bandwidth.
Dashboard supports apps, files, keys, and usage.
